result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's before_validation normalization (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`). The old setting explicitly allowed values like 'http://discourse.org' (see removed spec tests: `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = 'http://eviltrout.com'`), and the fabricator in this very diff uses hosts with http prefixes. EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares `lower(host) = uri.host`, so a migrated row stored as 'http://discourse.org' will never match 'discourse.org', b
